dest_address.title: Dest Address
dest_address.description: Destination for consolidated funds (bc1q.../bc1p... only). Defaults to the single source address if only one is given.

execution_template.title: Execution Template
execution_template.description: How aggressively to consolidate: low, moderate, high, or extreme.

dust_threshold.title: Dust Threshold
dust_threshold.description: Ignore UTXOs at or below this many sats.

confirm_privacy_cluster_merge.title: Confirm Privacy Cluster Merge
confirm_privacy_cluster_merge.description: Required (set true) when more than one source address is given. Consolidating UTXOs from multiple addresses into one transaction links them on-chain via the common-input-ownership heuristic -- irreversible, unlike an unfavorable fee. A single address never needs this.
